19850-the-human-side-of-animals.title: Of Animals
19850-the-human-side-of-animals.creator: Royal Dixon
19850-the-human-side-of-animals.description: A book by Royal Dixon. The porcupine and the hedgehog have a unique method of collecting  food for their young. After shaking down berries or grapes,  they roll in them, then hurry home with the food attached to  their quills 173

arxiv-2101-12288.title: From Geometry to Topology: Inverse Theorems for Distributed Persistence
arxiv-2101-12288.creator: Elchanan Solomon, Alexander Wagner, Paul Bendich
arxiv-2101-12288.description: Abstract What is the “right” topological invariant of a large point cloud X? Prior research has focused on estimating the full persistence diagram of X, a quantity that is very expensive to compute, unstable to outliers, and far from injective.

arxiv-2112-06357.title: An installation-level model of China’s coal sector shows how its decarbonization and energy security plans will reduce overseas coal imports
arxiv-2112-06357.creator: Jorrit Gosens, Alex Turnbull, Frank Jotzo
arxiv-2112-06357.description: Abstract China aims for net-zero carbon emissions by 2060, and an emissions peak before 2030. This will reduce its consumption of coal for power generation and steel making. Simultaneously, China aims for improved energy security, primarily with expanded domestic coal production and transport infrastructure.

arxiv-2305-06597.title: Nature of Some Solitons on Almost coKähler Manifolds and Asymptotically Harmonic Manifolds
arxiv-2305-06597.creator: Paritosh Ghosh, Hemangi Madhusudan Shah, Arindam Bhattacharyya
arxiv-2305-06597.description: Abstract . In this research, we study the nature of η \eta -Einstein and gradient η \eta -Einstein soliton in the framework of almost coKähler manifolds and ( κ , μ ) (\kappa,\mu) -almost coKähler manifolds. We find some expressions for scalar curvature of the almost coKähler manifold admitting η \eta -Einstein soliton in various cases.

arxiv-2305-10572.title: Tensor Products and Hyperdimensional Computing
arxiv-2305-10572.creator: Frank Qiu
arxiv-2305-10572.description: Abstract Following up on a previous analysis of graph embeddings, we generalize and expand some results to the general setting of vector symbolic architectures (VSA) and hyperdimensional computing (HDC). Importantly, we explore the mathematical relationship between superposition, orthogonality, and tensor product. We establish the tensor product representation as the central representation, with a suite of unique properties.

arxiv-2311-04398.title: Understanding the Role and Design Space of Demand Sinks in Low-carbon Power Systems Journal: Joule
arxiv-2311-04398.creator: Sam van der Jagt, Neha Patankar, Jesse D. Jenkins
arxiv-2311-04398.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sam van der Jagt, Neha Patankar, Jesse D. Jenkins. As the availability of weather-dependent, zero marginal cost resources such as wind and solar power increases, a variety of flexible electricity loads, or ‘demand sinks’, could be deployed to use intermittently available low-cost electricity to produce valuable outputs. This study provides a general framework to evaluate any potential demand sink technology and understand its viability to be deployed cost-effectively in low-carbon power systems.

arxiv-2503-10150.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Hierarchical Knowledge
arxiv-2503-10150.creator: Haoyu Huang, Yongfeng Huang, Junjie Yang, Zhenyu Pan, Yongqiang Chen, Kaili Ma, Hongzhi Chen, James Cheng
arxiv-2503-10150.description: Abstract Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods have significantly enhanced the performance of large language models (LLMs) in domain-specific tasks. However, existing RAG methods do not adequately utilize the naturally inherent hierarchical knowledge in human cognition, which limits the capabilities of RAG systems.

arxiv-2503-16264.title: Evaluating quality metrics through the lenses of psychophysical measurements of low-level vision
arxiv-2503-16264.creator: Dounia Hammou 1 , Yancheng Cai 1 , Pavan Madhusudanarao 2 , Christos G. Bampis 2 , Zhi Li 2 , Rafał K. Mantiuk 1
arxiv-2503-16264.description: Abstract Image and video quality metrics, such as SSIM, LPIPS, and VMAF, aim to predict perceived visual quality and are often assumed to reflect principles of human vision. However, relatively few metrics explicitly incorporate models of human perception, with most relying on hand-crafted formulas or data-driven training to approximate perceptual alignment.

Skram died, at an advanced age, at Urup on the 11th of July 1581. Skram’s audacity won for him the nickname of “Denmark’s dare-devil,” and he contributed perhaps more than any other Dane of his day to destroy the Hanseatic dominion of the Baltic. His humanity was equally remarkable; he often imperilled his life by preventing his crews from plundering.

pmc-10685259.title: Tackling standardization in clinical research workforce hiring using competency-based job classifications
pmc-10685259.creator: Christine Deeter, Deborah Hannah, Marissa Stroo, Rebecca Brouwer, Heather Gaudaur, Stephanie A. Freel, Denise C. Snyder
pmc-10685259.description: In 2016, Duke reconfigured its clinical research job descriptions and workforce to be competency-based, modeled around the Joint Taskforce for Clinical Trial Competency framework. To ensure consistency in job classification amongst new hires in the clinical research workforce, Duke subsequently implemented a Title Picker tool.

pmc-11477154.title: Comparative Analysis of Cystamine and Cysteamine as Radioprotectors and Antioxidants: Insights from Monte Carlo Chemical Modeling under High Linear Energy Transfer Radiation and High Dose Rates
pmc-11477154.creator: Samafou Penabeï, Jintana Meesungnoen, Jean-Paul Jay-Gerin
pmc-11477154.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study conducts a comparative analysis of cystamine (RSSR), a disulfide, and cysteamine (RSH), its thiol monomer, to evaluate their efficacy as radioprotectors and antioxidants under high linear energy transfer (LET) and high-dose-rate irradiation conditions. It examines their interactions with reactive primary species produced during the radiolysis of the aqueous ferrous sulfate (Fricke) dosimeter, offering insights into the mechanisms of radioprotection and highlighting their potential to enhance the therapeutic index of radiation therapy, particularly in advanced techniques like FLASH radiotherapy.

pmc-11693503.title: A rapid and reproducible method for generating germ-free Drosophila melanogaster
pmc-11693503.creator: An-Qi Li, Sha-Sha Li, Hui-Lin Li, Lan-Lan Zhong, Guo-Bao Tian, Xin-Yuan Zhao, Qiao-Ping Wang
pmc-11693503.description: Microbial communities exert a profound influence on various facets of animal behavior and physiology, making the comprehension of their interactions with hosts or the environment essential. Drosophila melanogaster, a widely recognized model organism, has been pivotal in elucidating host-microbe interactions.

pmc-12608647.title: Synthesis and Activity Evaluation of Novel Benzoxazepinone Derivatives as Potential Inhibitors of Glycogen Phosphorylase
pmc-12608647.creator: Dezhi Peng, Youde Wang, Zhiwei Yan, Shuai Li, Yachun Guo, Tienan Wang, Liying Zhang, Chiara Brullo
pmc-12608647.description: Glycogen phosphorylase (GP) is a key enzyme of glycogen catabolism, so it is significant to discover a new GP inhibitor. A series of benzoxazepinone derivatives were identified as glycogen phosphorylase (GP) inhibitors with potent activity. These compounds exhibited strong inhibitory effects. Among them, compound 8g (IC50 = 0.62 ± 0.

pmc-12613698.title: The effect of combination therapy on Bevacizumab, Carmustine, and Metformin chemotherapy drugs on the fluctuating performance expression of TLR2, TLR6, and IL-6 genes in the cell line of brain glioblastoma
pmc-12613698.creator: Seyedeh Elham Norollahi, Bahman Yousefi, Shahrokh Yousefzadeh-Chabok, Fatemeh Nejatifar, Mohammad Samadian, Mehdi Evazalipour, Mohamad Eftekhary, Masoud Faghih Akhlaghi, Ebrahim Mirzajani, Ali Rashidy-pour, Ali Akbar Samadani
pmc-12613698.description: ObjectiveGlioblastoma, one of the most aggressive brain tumors, is distinguished by its resistance to standard treatments. So, studying practical therapeutic methods is of great importance. In this project, the effects of combined chemotherapy drugs, including bevacizumab, carmustine, and metformin, on the expression of IL-6, TLR2, and TLR6 in the glioblastoma cell line of U87MG were investigated.

pmc-12972531.title: Troubleshooting intrathecal pumps in pain management: A clinical review
pmc-12972531.creator: Natalia Wojnowski, Salim M. Hayek, Shanee Abouzaglo, Kelly Li, R. Jason Yong, David Hao
pmc-12972531.description: Intrathecal drug delivery systems (IDDS), commonly known as pain pumps, have become an increasingly more prevalent method for management of refractory chronic pain, both non-cancer and cancer-related pain. IDDS are generally regarded as safe and reliable, however there is potential for complications leading to clinically significant consequences, such as accidental overdose, withdrawal and neurologic injury.

pmc-13375069.title: Correction to an immunometabolism‐related signature for renal clear cell carcinoma diagnosis and therapeutic target
pmc-13375069.creator: Unknown
pmc-13375069.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The online version of the article has been updated. We apologize for this error. Abstract

Kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC) lacks sensitive biomarkers for early diagnosis and effective guidance for personalized therapy. Given the close interplay between tumor metabolism and immune regulation, this study aimed to identify immunometabolism‐related biomarkers for KIRC and develop a robust diagnostic model. Transcriptomic datasets from TCGA and GEO were integrated, and immunometabolism‐related genes were collected from GeneCards.

pmc-13381956.title: Axial compression behavior and design of perforated high-strength steel square hollow section stub columns
pmc-13381956.creator: Joel T C Vanlalnunzira, Lalzuimuani Khiangte, Ricky Lalthazuala
pmc-13381956.description: Perforations are frequently introduced in steel structural members to accommodate service ducts and reduce structural weight; however, their presence can significantly affect the load-carrying capacity of compression members. This study presents a numerical investigation on the performance of cold-formed high-strength steel (CFHSS) square hollow section (SHS) stub columns having double-sided perforations.

pmc-13431983.title: Patient Profile and Referral Pattern in a Tertiary Care Infectious Disease Hospital of Bangladesh: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13431983.creator: Mohammad Jahid Hasan, Mohammad Mehedi Hasan Rabbi, Abdullah Al Tahsin Chowdhury, Zubayer Hasan, Ashish Paul, Ashrak Shad Pyash, Homayra Rahman Shoshi, Aninidita Das Barshan, Mohammad Abdullah Saeed Khan
pmc-13431983.description: IntroductionInfectious diseases are attributable to a large proportion of the disease burden in Bangladesh. The disease profile and referral pattern of these patients are important for understanding healthcare utilization and improving system efficiency in resource-limited settings. Hence, the objective of the present study was to assess the patient profiles and referral patterns at the Infectious Diseases Hospital (IDH), Dhaka, Bangladesh.

uslaw-usc-t25-s3703.title: 25 U.S.C. § 3703 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t25-s3703.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s3703.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 39 (American Indian Agricultural Resource Management). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For the purposes of this chapter: (1) The term “Indian agricultural lands” means Indian land, including farmland and rangeland, but excluding Indian forest land, that is used for the production of agricultural products, and Indian lands occupied by industries that support the agricultural community.
